name: business-operations
description: 6 BizOps skills + 1 orchestrator: process-mapper (BPMN + bottleneck + cycle-time), vendor-management (SLA + risk + scorecard), capacity-planner (Erlang-C queueing math for ops teams), internal-comms (ADKAR + Kotter 8-step change comms), knowledge-ops (SOP + runbook authoring with 5W2H validation), procurement-optimizer (UNSPSC-aligned spend categorization + supplier consolidation). The orchestrator skill routes inquiries to the right sub-skill via Matt Pocock grill discipline. 18 stdlib-only Python tools, reference docs citing authoritative sources, and asset templates per skill. Distinct from external sales and strategic-advisory plugins.
